output.reason: The setting can be identified, so a semantic-ambiguity undecidable leaf is wrong. The linked PR [ev-043428f564d1] names it as PACKAGE_RUNTIME, shown in env-var form, and says the old form "PACKAGE_RUNTIME=External" still works; the new PACKAGE_RUNTIME=Independent plus PACKAGE_FUNCTION_RUNTIME options are added, and providers stay Deployments by default. The other change in the PR applies only when the runtime is External: the TLS Server/Client Secret is no longer set by the Revision Parent, and Crossplane now reads the secret names from the Revision status [ev-93b2baca7cff]. Exposure is therefore environments that set PACKAGE_RUNTIME=External; environments that do not set it keep the default Deployment runtime.

correction.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 splits the PACKAGE_RUNTIME setting so functions (PACKAGE_FUNCTION_RUNTIME, enabled by PACKAGE_RUNTIME=Independent) and providers can use different runtimes. The old PACKAGE_RUNTIME=External still works, but with the External runtime the Revision Parent no longer sets TLS secrets; their names now come from the Revision status. Exposed: environments setting PACKAGE_RUNTIME=External.
